interface.recognize: recognize(ast, schema, *, identifier_encoding="dot", original_sql=None); original_sql required for verieql_double_underscore

common_frontend_contract: Every raw schema table/column is ASCII [A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*, contains no __, and names do not collide under uppercase within a namespace.
Reject raw SQL containing any backtick, double quote, or dollar sign. This is deliberately conservative, including strings/comments.
All five cost arms and each differential job apply this gate before Environment construction and SQL parsing.
FrontendUnsupported remains in the registered denominator and has full process/gate timing; no official parse/solve or fallback; not a SAT/UNSAT decision.
Only after raw gate admits input can algorithm Ineligible use original official fallback under the same remaining resource budget.
This is a necessary conservative identifier-safety gate; it does not prove all upstream SQL semantics or parser totality.

runtime_contract.per_job: fresh process and Environment for each admitted arm; complete schema, ICs, exact positive row counts; identical remaining CPU/wall budget
runtime_contract.cost: full process wall/CPU plus semantic E2E; includes contract checks, parse/recognize, encoding, solver, SAT SQLite replay, fallback, cleanup
runtime_contract.differential: separate correctness jobs; per query NULL/value mismatch vs official Scope output under unchanged premises; official auxiliary totality not established

not_done: no target/native import or solver execution
no runtime lock upgrade; parent registers and runs
no broadening of aggregate algorithm fragment
